environment.scope: isolated workspace, HTTP editor and headless Bevy on Linux

steps: Selected the two-scene project assembly, checked and built using the actual Bevy backend.
Saved a generated case as an author document linked to the entry scene.
Refreshed and explicitly reloaded the persisted case.
An external case edit is preserved on conflict, and the local UI draft remains intact.
After author scene edit, existing frozen project still runs and passes the original saved-case expectation.
Divergent author and frozen revisions are displayed; cancel prevents writing, then explicit confirmation saves against the author revision.
All author files outside the explicitly edited scene, case document and new registry record have identical hashes.
